claude_proposed_widenings.name: build_time_species_lineage_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit is one species trait whose payload is a persistent choose-one branch, not a flat passive grant list or an activation. The current surface only has cast-time choice inside activation phases, not build-time choice for non-spell traits.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: level_gated_species_trait_grants
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The chosen lineage keeps granting additional benefits at character levels 3 and 5. Current SpeciesTraitMechanics has passive or activation families only, with no way to attach later character-level grants inside the same trait.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: granted_spell_access_with_chosen_spellcasting_ability
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants are not just prepared/free-cast grants; they also carry a chosen casting ability from a closed list. Existing grant_spell_access can describe access mode, but not which ability powers the granted casts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: replace_granted_cantrip_on_long_rest
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The High Elf branch includes a recurring long-rest replacement rule for the granted cantrip. That is not representable as passive grants or grant_spell_access today.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.
